name: task
description: Execute a dual-agent consensus workflow for planning and/or implementation. Two AI agents (proposer + reviewer) iterate until consensus on a plan, then optionally execute it.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The task description or code change request.

parameters.name: --plan
parameters.description: Run planning phase only (skip implementation).

parameters.name: --full
parameters.description: Run full workflow: planning + implementation. This is the default.

parameters.name: --execute
parameters.description: Skip planning, execute implementation directly.

parameters.name: --confirm
parameters.description: Plan first, then wait for user approval before implementing.

parameters.name: --model
parameters.description: Override the LLM model (e.g., 'opus', 'sonnet', 'claude-opus-4-6').

parameters.name: --claude-only
parameters.description: Use Claude Code for both proposer and reviewer agents.

parameters.name: --analysis
parameters.description: Enable post-implementation analysis phase.

parameters.name: --multi-iter
parameters.description: Enable multi-iteration refinement loop.

parameters.name: --no-planning
parameters.description: Skip the planning phase entirely.

parameters.name: --no-implementation
parameters.description: Skip the implementation phase entirely.

parameters.name: --base-inferencer
parameters.description: Planner/base agent inferencer type.

parameters.name: --review-inferencer
parameters.description: Reviewer agent inferencer type.

parameters.name: --resume
parameters.description: Resume from an existing workspace directory.

parameters.name: --analysis-only
parameters.description: Resume workspace and run analysis only (sets --no-planning --no-implementation --analysis).

parameters.name: --analysis-mode
parameters.description: Analysis comparison mode.

parameters.name: --copy-workspace
parameters.description: Force copy workspace on resume.

parameters.name: --in-place
parameters.description: Don't copy workspace on resume (modify in place).

parameters.name: --replay-streaming
parameters.description: Replay streamed output from previously completed phases.

parameters.name: --initial-plan
parameters.description: Load initial plan from file, skip the proposal phase.

parameters.name: --use-proposal
parameters.description: Path to proposals.json from a research_propose run. Selected proposals seed the plan phase. Mutually exclusive with --initial-plan.

parameters.name: --proposal-ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated proposal IDs to pick (e.g., 'P1,P3'). Used with --use-proposal. Omit to pick all.

parameters.name: --tool-name
parameters.description: Workspace identity — controls directory naming under _runtime/tasks/. Default: 'task'. E.g., 'understand_codebase' creates tasks/understand_codebase/understand_codebase_<ts>/.

parameters.name: --config
parameters.description: Topology config: preset name (e.g., 'default'), YAML path, or inline YAML. Defaults to 'default'.

parameters.name: --override
parameters.description: YAML config override as key=value. Repeatable. E.g.: --override '_params.default_inferencer=RovoDevCLI' --override '_params.plan_max_breakdown=4'

parameters.name: --template-version
parameters.description: Template variant version suffix for variable resolution (e.g., 'aggregation').

parameters.name: --template-master-version
parameters.description: Template master version for subdirectory routing (e.g., 'understand_codebase').

returns: Workspace path containing plan and/or implementation outputs at _rankevolve_workspace/task_<timestamp>/.
examples: task "Implement flash attention v2 for HSTU model"
task --plan "Add unit tests for the recommendation service"
task --confirm "Refactor the data pipeline to use async I/O"
